source: Phish Drill Arena question bank (builds/2_phish_drill_arena/data/bank.json), fictional company Northwind Dynamics

questions.subject: Urgent wire needed
questions.lesson: Executive + new payee + secrecy = stop and call the executive on a known number.
questions.body:
Are you at your desk? I need you to process an urgent wire of $48,500 to a new supplier today.
I'm in a board meeting and can't take calls. Keep this between us until it's announced.
David

questions.subject: Your mailbox will be suspended in 24 hours
questions.lesson: Hover every link: the text is a costume, the real URL is the person.
questions.body:
Dear user, your mailbox storage verification has failed.
To avoid suspension, confirm your password within 24 hours using the secure link below.
Mail Administration Team

questions.subject: Invoice #88213 overdue - see attached
questions.lesson: Invoices never arrive as .html files.
questions.body:
Final notice: invoice #88213 is overdue.
Open the attached invoice and settle today to avoid collection fees.

questions.subject: change of bank account
questions.lesson: Bank change by email = call the number already in the vendor master.
questions.body:
Dear customer, we have changed our bank.
Please update the account for all payments effective immediately: First Coastal Bank, acct 99887766, routing 021000999.
Reply to this email to confirm the change.

questions.subject: direct deposit
questions.lesson: Payroll changes only through the HR portal — no exceptions.
questions.body:
Hi, I changed my bank. Can you update my direct deposit before this Friday's payroll?
I can't login to the HR portal from my phone. New account: 55102938, routing 011000777.
Thanks, Maria

questions.subject: Annual domain renewal - action required
questions.lesson: No PO, unknown vendor → don't pay; report.
questions.body:
Your annual domain & SSL renewal of $1,890.00 is due.
Failure to pay will suspend your domain within 48 hours.
Click Pay now to keep your website online.

questions.subject: Invoice INV-4471 for PO-2291
questions.lesson: Known vendor + real PO + no bank change = normal invoice.
questions.body:
Hello Northwind AP team,
Please find attached invoice INV-4471 for PO-2291 (240 units, delivered Oct 28), total $12,480.00.
Payment terms Net 30 to the same account on file. Thank you for your business!

questions.subject: October freight statement
questions.lesson: Routine, matching, nothing changed.
questions.body:
Your October freight statement is ready: 14 shipments, total $3,215.40.
As usual, view and download it from our billing portal.

questions.subject: New remittance details from December
questions.lesson: Real domain is not proof. Hold and call the vendor-master number.
questions.body:
Our firm is moving banks next month.
New remittance details are attached. Please update your records before our next invoice.
Best, Jordan Ortiz — Accounts, Harbor Legal LLP

questions.subject: Your pay stub is ready
questions.lesson: Go to the portal yourself; never via the email link.
questions.body:
Your November pay stub is available.
Sign in with your company email and password to view it.

questions.subject: Month-end: approved batch APR-5510
questions.lesson: Internal + existing approval + normal system = proceed.
questions.body:
Hi team, month-end close reminder.
Please pay the approved invoices in batch APR-5510 in the AP system by Thursday.
Thanks! Amy

questions.subject: INV-4502 / PO-2318 - remittance update
questions.lesson: Read the domain letter by letter. 1 ≠ l.
questions.body:
Hello Northwind AP team,
Thank you for PO-2318. Invoice INV-4502 for $48,700.00 is attached.
Due to an audit of our banking arrangements, remittances should now go to our account at Summit Bank, ending 4410.
Please do not call our old line — it is being retired this week.

questions.subject: Confidential - quick favor
questions.lesson: Secret deal + outside counsel + no call = CEO fraud script.
questions.body:
Quick favor — I'm finalizing a confidential acquisition.
Our outside counsel will send wiring instructions this afternoon. Treat it as priority and don't discuss with the team until we announce.
Sent from my iPhone

questions.subject: Amy Chen shared "Q4 Vendor Payments.xlsx" with you
questions.lesson: Read a URL right-to-left from the first single slash: the last domain owns it.
questions.body:
Amy Chen has shared a document with you via DocuSafe.
Review Document
Sign in with your Northwind email to access the file.

questions.subject: Revised freight statement (October)
questions.lesson: Macros from email = never enable.
questions.body:
Please see the revised October statement attached.
If the totals don't show, click Enable Editing and Enable Content.

questions.subject: Invoice CC-7741 - additional seats
questions.lesson: Check the invoice against the PO and the contract.
questions.body:
Invoice CC-7741: 120 additional seats, $9,840.00.
Note: we moved to a new remittance account; details on the invoice.
Questions? Reply to this email.

questions.subject: Payroll run #1107 failed - action needed before 5 PM
questions.lesson: Payroll alarms: open the portal yourself.
questions.body:
Your payroll run #1107 failed due to an expired admin session.
Re-enter your admin credentials to release payroll before 5 PM, or employees will not be paid today.

questions.subject: Order 7781 - updated ACH form
questions.lesson: Right domain, wrong department, bank change → verify.
questions.body:
Hi, thanks for Order 7781 — it ships Monday.
Our finance team asked us to send the updated ACH form for future payments (attached).
Have a great week, Kim

questions.subject: Approved: Harbor Legal HL-2210
questions.lesson: Approval in the system, not just in an email.
questions.body:
Approved — please release payment for Harbor Legal invoice HL-2210 ($8,450).
Approval is logged in the AP system as APR-5531.

questions.subject: Invoice DP-9902 / PO-2330
questions.lesson: Normal invoice.
questions.body:
Invoice DP-9902 for PO-2330 attached, $2,740.00, Net 30.
Remit to the account on file. Thanks!

questions.subject: Payroll run #1108 completed
questions.lesson: Notifications that ask for nothing are low risk.
questions.body:
Payroll run #1108 completed. Funding of $182,400 will be debited per schedule.
No action required. View the summary in the portal.

questions.subject: Renewal receipt - 40 seats
questions.lesson: Matches contract, nothing changed.
questions.body:
Your annual renewal for 40 seats ($4,800.00) will be charged to the card on file per contract CC-2025-11.
No changes to your plan or billing details.

questions.subject: Maria's direct deposit
questions.lesson: Second-hand bank changes: confirm with the employee directly.
questions.body:
Maria Gomez stopped by and asked me to update her direct deposit — can you change it in payroll today?
New account ending 2938. Thanks!

questions.subject: RE: INV-4519 / PO-2342 - payment timing
questions.lesson: Real mailbox + real thread can still be hijacked. Bank change → call back.
questions.body:
Hi Jordan, as discussed on our call, please use our new receiving account for this one (ending 7720) — our main account is frozen during the audit.
Everything else stays the same. Appreciate the help!
> On Nov 3, Jordan (Northwind AP) wrote:
> Thanks — INV-4519 is scheduled for Friday's run.

questions.subject: RE: October freight statement
questions.lesson: Always compare From AND Reply-To.
questions.body:
Thanks Jordan. Quick update: going forward please remit to our new account at Harbor Trust (details attached).
Reply here once updated so we can close the ticket.
> On Nov 2, Jordan (Northwind AP) wrote:
> Received, will pay with the next run.

questions.subject: Harbor settlement - wire before 2 PM
questions.lesson: A perfect From line can be forged; check Authentication-Results.
questions.body:
Amy is out today. Treasury needs the Harbor Legal settlement wired before the 2 PM cutoff — $185,000.
Instructions attached. I'll sign the approval form when I'm back.

questions.subject: Annual renewal - remittance update
questions.lesson: Homoglyphs: copy the domain into the vendor master search instead of trusting your eyes.
questions.body:
Your annual renewal is unchanged at $14,400.
Following our merger with Strata Pay, our remittance address has changed. Updated details are in the billing portal.

questions.subject: Invoice DP-9931 / PO-2345
questions.lesson: Read domains from the right.
questions.body:
Invoice DP-9931 for PO-2345 is ready, $6,380.00.
View statement and pay online.

questions.subject: Updated direct deposit - Maria Gomez
questions.lesson: Even internal senders: check Reply-To.
questions.body:
Per the attached updated direct deposit form from Maria Gomez, please apply it to this Friday's run.
HR portal is down for maintenance, so please just update it directly.

questions.subject: Action required: MFA re-enrollment
questions.lesson: QR codes are links you can't hover.
questions.body:
As part of our security upgrade, all finance users must re-register your MFA device by end of day.
Scan the QR code in the attachment with your phone camera.

questions.subject: new vendor today
questions.lesson: Genuine sender, abnormal request → verify on a known channel.
questions.body:
Can you add a new vendor 'Strata Advisory' and pay their retainer of $22,000 today?
The contract is in my inbox, I'll forward later.

questions.subject: Remittance advice - payment received
questions.lesson: Trusted sender + .htm + sign-in = compromised vendor.
questions.body:
Thank you for your payment. Your remittance advice is attached.
Sign in with your Microsoft account to view the secure document.

questions.subject: URGENT: Invoice HL-2244 due Friday
questions.lesson: Urgent ≠ phish. Look for what changed — here, nothing.
questions.body:
Friendly but urgent reminder: invoice HL-2244 ($6,900) per our engagement letter is due Friday.
Please pay via the account on file. Thank you!

questions.subject: Q3 vendor payments approved
questions.lesson: CEO name ≠ fraud. Check what's being asked.
questions.body:
Thanks team — Q3 vendor payments are approved in the AP system (batch APR-5602).
Proceed with the scheduled run.

questions.subject: RE: October statement - corrected total
questions.lesson: A thread reply that answers your question and changes nothing is fine.
questions.body:
Hi Jordan, apologies — corrected October statement attached. New total $3,190.00 (one duplicate shipment removed).
Same account on file as always.
> On Nov 4, Jordan (Northwind AP) wrote:
> Shipment 8812 looks duplicated?

questions.subject: 2027 price list + INV-4530
questions.lesson: Normal.
questions.body:
Attached: our 2027 price list and invoice INV-4530 for PO-2350 ($5,420.00).
No change to payment details — keep using the account on file.

questions.subject: Need W-2s for all staff
questions.lesson: Employee data never leaves via email on request — verify in person.
questions.body:
I need a PDF of all employee W-2 forms for 2026 for a meeting with the auditors in an hour.
Send them straight to me here, don't loop in HR.

questions.subject: Off-cycle payment - consultant
questions.lesson: Never skip dual approval because of an email.
questions.body:
Please run an off-cycle payroll payment of $18,750 to our new contractor today, details below.
I'm traveling, so skip the second approval this time — I'll sign off on Monday.

questions.subject: Benefits audit - employee roster
questions.lesson: Internal sender, sensitive data, outside recipient → verify with HR by phone.
questions.body:
The benefits broker needs an updated employee roster with SSNs and home addresses for the open-enrollment audit.
Could you export it from payroll and email it to them at enroll@benefits-partner.net?

questions.subject: Holiday payroll calendar
questions.lesson: Informational notices that ask for nothing are fine.
questions.body:
Reminder: the Thanksgiving payroll run will process one day early, on Wednesday.
No action needed if your approvals are complete in the portal.
